author: Bobby Grayson
description: Predicted the mutex proof would need rework for the await state; in practice the six counters and two equations were untouched. The rework was mechanical: three client shapes instead of two phases, reply .ok instead of grant, and the deferral clause is a frame case (popped message re-sent to self does not touch any counted message).
title: The CPS split did not change the invariant at all: only the view (locOf) that maps the generated await constructor to 'waiting'. Blocking calls are a compilation detail of the client, not a protocol change
